name: mail-rejects-since-morning
description: A partner says messages from the production fail validation since this morning and asks for a look at the failed messages: a current failure that OcuTalon can look into with its read-only tools, so it acts.

item.subject: Your results messages fail our validation
item.text: Hello, since this morning every results message from your production fails our validation, and our system rejects it. Please check the failed messages in your production and see what changed. Thanks, Results Partner IT
